name: The AI Pound: UGC ad scripts (with compliance check)

parameters.formDescription: The AI Pound: compliant UGC-style ad scripts for UK health & beauty brands. Scripts arrive on Telegram for review.

values.placeholder: e.g. women 30-45 in the UK with dry, sensitive skin
What should viewers feel or do? Any offer?

values.fieldLabel: Evidence the brand holds for its claims
values.placeholder: e.g. 2025 consumer study (n=112), dermatologist tested. Leave blank if none.

values.formSubmittedText: Thanks! Your scripts and compliance check will arrive on Telegram in about a minute.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Settings').first().json.model, temperature: 0.8, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are a senior UK UGC ad scriptwriter. Write scroll-stopping, natural, first-person UGC-style short video ad scripts for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. UK rules you must follow (ASA/CAP Code, ASA cosmetic-interventions guidance, Human Medicines Regulations 2012): 1) No guaranteed, permanent or specific results and no 'risk-free' or 'no side effects' claims. 2) Cosmetics may make cosmetic claims only (looks/feels), never medical claims (treats, cures, heals) unless licensed. 3) Never name, show or imply prescription-only medicines (e.g. semaglutide, Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, tirzepatide, Botox, finasteride, 'the jab', 'skinny pen'). 4) Weight management: no amount or rate of weight loss, no before/after that exaggerates, nothing aimed at under-18s. 5) Cosmetic interventions incl. hair transplants: don't trivialise surgery, no time-limited or pressure offers, no under-18s, no guaranteed outcomes; before/after only if real, unedited and representative. 6) Objective claims (e.g. 'clinically proven', percentages) only if the brand's stated evidence supports them. 7) It's an ad: the caption must start with 'Ad |' and the creator must not be presented as an unpaid customer. Never invent testimonials or reviews. Return only JSON: {\"scripts\":[{\"angle\":\"\",\"hook\":\"first 2 seconds, spoken\",\"script\":[{\"time\":\"0-3s\",\"visual\":\"\",\"line\":\"\"}],\"on_screen_text\":[\"\"],\"cta\":\"\",\"caption\":\"Ad | ...\",\"claims\":[\"each objective claim made\"]}]}. Each script must use a different angle." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Brief: ' + JSON.stringify($json) } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Settings').first().json.model, temperature: 0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are a strict UK advertising compliance reviewer for health and beauty ads. UK rules you must follow (ASA/CAP Code, ASA cosmetic-interventions guidance, Human Medicines Regulations 2012): 1) No guaranteed, permanent or specific results and no 'risk-free' or 'no side effects' claims. 2) Cosmetics may make cosmetic claims only (looks/feels), never medical claims (treats, cures, heals) unless licensed. 3) Never name, show or imply prescription-only medicines (e.g. semaglutide, Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, tirzepatide, Botox, finasteride, 'the jab', 'skinny pen'). 4) Weight management: no amount or rate of weight loss, no before/after that exaggerates, nothing aimed at under-18s. 5) Cosmetic interventions incl. hair transplants: don't trivialise surgery, no time-limited or pressure offers, no under-18s, no guaranteed outcomes; before/after only if real, unedited and representative. 6) Objective claims (e.g. 'clinically proven', percentages) only if the brand's stated evidence supports them. 7) It's an ad: the caption must start with 'Ad |' and the creator must not be presented as an unpaid customer. Never invent testimonials or reviews. Review every script line, on-screen text, CTA and caption against these rules and the brand's stated evidence. Return only JSON: {\"reviews\":[{\"index\":0,\"verdict\":\"pass\"|\"needs_changes\",\"issues\":[{\"quote\":\"\",\"rule\":\"\",\"why\":\"\",\"fix\":\"\"}]}]}. Flag anything doubtful." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Brand evidence: ' + ($('Brief').first().json.evidence || 'none provided') + '\nCategory: ' + $('Brief').first().json.category + '\nScripts: ' + JSON.stringify($json.scripts) } ] }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return $('One message per script').all().map(i => ({ json: i.json.row }));

parameters.message: ={{ '📝 ' + $('Brief').first().json.brand + ': ' + $('Rows').all().length + ' scripts ready. Pass: ' + $('Rows').all().filter(r => r.json.verdict === 'pass').length + ', needs changes: ' + $('Rows').all().filter(r => r.json.verdict === 'needs_changes').length + ', blocked: ' + $('Rows').all().filter(r => r.json.verdict === 'blocked').length + '.\n\nApprove the PASS scripts to send to the client? (Compliance checks are guidance, not legal advice.)' }}

parameters.content:
## UGC script writer
Form → AI writes scripts → rule check + AI compliance review → Telegram → Ad Scripts tab → approve.
Compliance output is guidance, not legal advice.
